proposals.expected_signal: Improved NDCG@10 if modest stochastic edge dropout plus a lightweight contrastive auxiliary reduces over-smoothing and sharpens item discrimination without destabilizing pairwise ranking.
proposals.failure_mode: Contrastive weight or dropout rate is too strong, hurting the ranking objective and causing weaker top-10 ordering than the plain graph baseline.
proposals.hypothesis: On ML-1M full-sort ranking, a LightGCN-style propagator with the standard pairwise ranking loss plus a small contrastive auxiliary across two uniformly edge-dropped graph views can improve retrieval quality by making user/item embeddings more robust while preserving the strong base recommender behavior.
